name: uMOVA Complete on Next for LearnPress
author: Oles Dmytrenko

sections.description:
Removes the Complete button and confirmation step. Automatically marks lessons as completed on clicking Next. The plugin uses LearnPress’s native completion process before navigating forward.

The separate Complete button is hidden. LearnPress remains responsible for recording lesson progress and confirming completion. The plugin does not automatically complete quizzes.

Features

  • Mark the current lesson as completed by clicking Next.
  • Hide the separate Complete button.
  • Preserve LearnPress’s native lesson completion process.
  • Update the lesson’s completion indicator using the server-rendered curriculum status.
  • Leave quiz navigation and already-completed lessons to their normal navigation behavior.
  • No settings required.

Learn more: https://plugins.umova.online/complete-on-next/

Developed by Oles Dmytrenko.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate LearnPress.
  2. Install and activate uMOVA Complete on Next for LearnPress.
  3. Open a LearnPress lesson and click Next to complete the lesson and move forward.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically complete quizzes?

No. It completes lessons when students click Next. Quiz behavior remains controlled by LearnPress.

Does the plugin change LearnPress completion records?

It submits the native LearnPress lesson completion form. LearnPress processes and confirms completion.

Does the plugin need configuration?

No. Activate the plugin to use it.
